notes.title: Update to version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who has already downloaded the game and tried it out. Even more thanks to those who left a meaningful review on the game page. And even more thanks to those who helped find several bugs. We have fixed these bugs, namely:
- several images in the knowledge base were mixed up - FIXED
- a black screen was displayed during the mini-game in Chapter 8 - FIXED
- the interface in the knowledge base was not displayed correctly on ultra-wide monitors - FIXED

Thank you all and have a nice weekend,
Your Koalas
